sam-support: Customer CUST-478 reporting p99 spike for /v1/generate from eu-west1 — p95 ~350ms but p99 jumped to 6.8s starting ~08:12 UTC. Customer traces show TLS handshake timeouts and TCP retransmits. Request IDs: r_3309a, r_3309b. Attaching curl timings and a few logs.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: service-edge-eu-west1 p99 latency >5s (08:12 UTC)

priya: I'm on it. sam, can you paste one example request id + full curl -v timing output so I can correlate with tcpdump? Also did they change model size or prompt length?

sam-support: model & prompt unchanged. Example:
```
$ curl -w "time_namelookup:%{time_namelookup}\ntime_connect:%{time_connect}\ntime_appconnect:%{time_appconnect}\ntime_starttransfer:%{time_starttransfer}\ntime_total:%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null -s "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>"
# output:
time_namelookup:0.012
time_connect:0.042
time_appconnect:6.421
time_starttransfer:6.480
time_total:6.55
request_id: r_3309a
```

alex: I pulled infra traces — spike correlates with a GSLB routing change at 08:05 (config push: gslb-2024-11-08-08:05). My initial hunch: aggressive healthcheck/failover + low DNS TTL causing route oscillation -> some flows hairpin through eu-west-2 provider -> extra 40-60ms + TLS handshake restarts. Running `dig` + `tcptraceroute` now.

irene: tcptraceroute ->
```
1 10.5.1.1 0.8 ms
2 52.30.10.5 3.2 ms
3 35.176.9.2 5.1 ms
4 84.252.17.45 (provider-x-eu-west-2) 45.3 ms  <-- unexpected
5 34.120.22.8 48.7 ms
```
hop 4 indicates egress via provider-x in a different AZ/region; that 45ms explains TLS handshake blowup on p99. Seen SYN retransmits around same times in tcpdump.

priya: Proposed mitigations: 1) roll back GSLB change to previous config (gslb-2024-11-08-07:50) 2) temporarily increase TTL to 30s to avoid flapping 3) add route preference to avoid provider-x for eu-west for 10m 4) scale frontend pool by +30% to absorb inflight retries. Any objections?

alex: No objections. Rolling back now (rollback-id: rb-3309991250). Also pushed a temporary egress steering rule: `egress.pref = prefer_direct_peers` with priority 100. Deploy log: deploy-3309991250 started -> success :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Rollback complete. New metrics: p99 reduced from 6.8s -> 260ms within 90s of rollback. Monitoring for 20m.

sam-support: Customer CUST-478 confirms latency is back to normal and no errors seen. They'll keep us posted. Thanks team :heart:

priya: I'll file a short postmortem with timeline + action items (PM-1123). Closing this thread once postmortem linked.
